derivation: ext x; exact starProjection_orthogonal_apply_eq_zero (U := U) (U.starProjection_apply_mem x)
explanation: Mathlib says the projection onto `Uᗮ` vanishes on vectors in `U`. The image of `U.starProjection` lies in `U`, so applying that result pointwise gives the zero sine map. The existing proof instead uses the theorem’s own `sinThetaMap_eq_zero_iff`.
